text_en: The Lord dealt with Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did for Sarah as he had promised.
text_cn: 上主照所许的，眷顾了撒辣；上主对撒辣实践了他所说的话。

text_en: Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the time of which God had spoken to him.
text_cn: 撒辣怀了孕，在天主所许的时期，给年老的亚巴郎生了一个儿子。

text_en: Abraham gave the name Isaac to his son whom Sarah bore him.
text_cn: 亚巴郎为撒辣给他所生的儿子，起名叫依撒格。

text_en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
text_cn: 生后第八天，亚巴郎照天主所吩咐的给自己的儿子依撒格行了割损。

text_en: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
text_cn: 他儿子依撒格诞生时，亚巴郎正一百岁；

text_en: Now Sarah said, “God has brought laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh with me. ”
text_cn: 为此撒辣说：“天主使我笑，凡听见的也要与我一同笑。”

text_en: And she said, “Who would ever have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age. ”
text_cn: 又说：“谁能告诉亚巴郎，撒辣要哺养儿子呢？可是我在他老年，却给他生了个儿子。”

text_en: The child grew, and was weaned; and Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
text_cn: 孩子渐渐长大，断了乳；在依撒格断乳的那天，亚巴郎摆了盛宴。

text_en: But Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, playing with her son Isaac.
text_cn: 撒辣见那埃及女人哈加尔给亚巴郎生的儿子，戏笑自己的儿子依撒格，

text_en: So she said to Abraham, “Cast out this slave woman with her son; for the son of this slave woman shall not inherit along with my son Isaac. ”
text_cn: 就对亚巴郎说：“你该赶走这婢女和她的儿子，因为这婢女的儿子不能和我的儿子依撒格一同承受家业。”

text_en: The matter was very distressing to Abraham on account of his son.
text_cn: 亚巴郎为了他这儿子的事很是苦恼。

text_en: But God said to Abraham, “Do not be distressed because of the boy and because of your slave woman; whatever Sarah says to you, do as she tells you, for it is through Isaac that offspring shall be named for you.
text_cn: 但天主对亚巴郎说：“你不必为这孩子和你的婢女苦恼；凡撒辣对你说的，你都可听从，因为只有藉依撒格你的名才能传后。

text_en: As for the son of the slave woman, I will make a nation of him also, because he is your offspring. ”
text_cn: 至于这婢女的儿子，我也要使他成为一大民族，因为他也是你的孩子。”

text_en: So Abraham rose early in the morning, and took bread and a skin of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, along with the child, and sent her away. And she departed, and wandered about in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
text_cn: 第二天，亚巴郎清早起来，拿了饼和一皮囊水，交给哈加尔，放在她肩上，又将孩子交给她，打发她走了。她一路前行，在贝尔舍巴旷野迷失了路。

text_en: When the water in the skin was gone, she cast the child under one of the bushes.
text_cn: 那时皮囊里的水已用尽，她把孩子丢在一堆小树下，

text_en: Then she went and sat down opposite him a good way off, about the distance of a bowshot; for she said, “Do not let me look on the death of the child. ” And as she sat opposite him, she lifted up her voice and wept.
text_cn: 自己走开，在约离一箭之远的对面坐下，自言自语说：“我不忍见这孩子夭折。”就坐在对面放声大哭。

text_en: And God heard the voice of the boy; and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Do not be afraid; for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
text_cn: 天主听见孩子啼哭，天主的使者由天上呼唤哈加尔说：“哈加尔！你有什么事？不要害怕，因为天主已听见孩子在那里的哭声。

text_en: Come, lift up the boy and hold him fast with your hand, for I will make a great nation of him. ”
text_cn: 起来，去扶起孩子来，用手搀着他，因为我要使他成为一大民族。”

text_en: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. She went, and filled the skin with water, and gave the boy a drink.
text_cn: 天主于是开了她的眼，她看见了一口水井，遂去将皮囊灌满了水，给孩子喝。

text_en: God was with the boy, and he grew up; he lived in the wilderness, and became an expert with the bow.
text_cn: 天主与孩子同在，他渐渐长大，住在旷野，成了个弓手。

text_en: He lived in the wilderness of Paran; and his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 他住在帕兰旷野；他母亲由埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。

text_en: At that time Abimelech, with Phicol the commander of his army, said to Abraham, “God is with you in all that you do;
text_cn: 那时阿彼默肋客同他的司令非苛耳对亚巴郎说：“在你所作的一切事上，天主常与你同在。

text_en: now therefore swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me or with my offspring or with my posterity, but as I have dealt loyally with you, you will deal with me and with the land where you have resided as an alien. ”
text_cn: 现在你在这里要指着天主对我起誓：总不要亏待我和我的子子孙孙。我怎样厚待了你，你也要怎样厚待我和你寄居的地方。”

text_en: And Abraham said, “I swear it. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎回答说：“我愿起誓。”

text_en: When Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well of water that Abimelech’s servants had seized,
text_cn: 亚巴郎为了阿彼默肋客的仆人霸占了一口水井，就责斥阿彼默肋客。

text_en: Abimelech said, “I do not know who has done this; you did not tell me, and I have not heard of it until today. ”
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客回答说：“我不知道谁作了这事，你也没有通知我，我到今天才听说。”

text_en: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.
text_cn: 亚巴郎遂把牛羊交给阿彼默肋客，二人互相立了约。

text_en: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs of the flock.
text_cn: 亚巴郎又将羊群中七只母羔羊，另放在一边。

text_en: And Abimelech said to Abraham, “What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs that you have set apart? ”
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客问亚巴郎说：“将这七只母羔羊另放在一边，请问有什么意思？”

text_en: He said, “These seven ewe lambs you shall accept from my hand, in order that you may be a witness for me that I dug this well. ”
text_cn: 他答说：“你要由我手中接受这七只母羔羊，作我挖了这口水井的凭据。”

text_en: Therefore that place was called Beer-sheba; because there both of them swore an oath.
text_cn: 因为他们二人在那里起了誓，为此那地方叫做贝尔舍巴。

text_en: When they had made a covenant at Beer-sheba, Abimelech, with Phicol the commander of his army, left and returned to the land of the Philistines.
text_cn: 他们在贝尔舍巴立了约，阿彼默肋客同他的司令非苛耳起身回培肋舍特地去了。

text_en: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord , the Everlasting God.
text_cn: 亚巴郎在贝尔舍巴栽了一株柽柳（chēng liu），在那里呼求了上主，永恒天主的名。

text_en: And Abraham resided as an alien many days in the land of the Philistines.
text_cn: 亚巴郎在培肋舍特人地内住了许久。
